Good to know.

How do I order or check a price?

Add products to My selection, then prepare an enquiry. Copy your message, open Viber and paste and send it to 09-4150440. You can also call Oliveco directly. Our team will confirm current prices, pack sizes and availability before you place an order.

What can the product guide help with?

The guide helps you find products, compare catalog descriptions, check listed ingredients and sizes, and contact Oliveco. It uses the supplied Oliveco catalogs. Product information is not personal medical advice.

Are these the original product photographs?

The studio-style product images are based on photographs from the supplied Oliveco catalogues. Some products have multiple packaging formats. Ask our team to confirm current packaging and sizes before ordering. The main lifestyle photograph is illustrative.

Where is Oliveco based?

No. N-8/(29+36), 69th Street, between 37th and 38th Streets, Maha Myaing (1) Ward, Maha Aung Myay Township, Mandalay, Myanmar. Call 02-4036795, 02-2832238 or 09-4150440 to confirm opening hours before visiting.
